verifiedRecords.guarantee: Proper edge coloring with high probability
verifiedRecords.sourceLocation: Corollary 2, printed p. 15:4; Theorem 1 and Lemma 7
verifiedRecords.notes: The tilde hides factors depending on log n. Corollary 3 separately assumes Δ=n^Ω(1) and obtains sublinear local space with a different palette. That polynomial-degree regime is not the low-degree regime of the other panel.
verifiedRecords.graph: General simple undirected graph with n vertices, m edges and maximum degree Δ
verifiedRecords.output: Explicit proper edge coloring; both endpoints agree on each edge color
verifiedRecords.resourceModel: Synchronous MPC communication rounds; memory in words of O(log n) bits
verifiedRecords.quality: Proper edge coloring using at most Δ+Õ(Δ³ᐟ⁴) colors
verifiedRecords.exactBound: O(1) MPC rounds; palette Δ+Õ(Δ³ᐟ⁴); O(n) local words and O(m) total words
verifiedRecords.localComputation: Standard MPC permits unrestricted local computation; each assigned subgraph is colored locally using Vizing’s theorem
verifiedRecords.stability: No component-stability claim is needed for this randomized upper bound
verifiedRecords.probability: Randomized; successful proper coloring and stated space bounds with probability 1−1/poly(n)
assumptions: Simple graph; input is an edge list distributed among machines
O(n) local memory and O(m) total memory, measured in words
Unlimited local computation in the MPC round model
No claim that Δ+Õ(Δ³ᐟ⁴) equals Δ+o(Δ) for bounded Δ

verifiedRecords.notes: For sufficiently large fixed Δ, the palette is at most 2Δ−2 and the round bound is O(log log log n), with polynomial local computation. This is an asymptotic specialization, not a claim for every small fixed degree. No exponent is specified for poly(Δ).

verifiedRecords.guarantee: q=2Δ−2 edge coloring, even on forests
verifiedRecords.notes: The logarithm is log(log_Δ n), not log_Δ(log n). Component stability permits the global parameters allowed by the paper’s formal definition; it does not mean that machines cannot communicate across components. This is not a matched lower bound for Theorem 21.
verifiedRecords.graph: Lower bound holds even for forests of maximum degree Δ; use Δ≥3
verifiedRecords.output: Explicit proper edge coloring; both endpoints agree on each edge color
verifiedRecords.resourceModel: Synchronous MPC communication rounds; memory in words of O(log n) bits

verifiedRecords.exactBound: No deterministic component-stable low-space MPC algorithm uses o(log(log_Δ n)) rounds, assuming the connectivity conjecture
verifiedRecords.totalSpace: Any polynomial total space is allowed by the lower-bound model
verifiedRecords.localComputation: Arbitrary local computation is allowed; this lower bound counts MPC rounds
